# tsb_extension_ui_extension (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Reference of the OCI image that contains the UI extension package. It must be a fully qualified reference pinned to a digest, as in `registry/repository@sha256:<digest>`; an optional tag may be present before the digest. References without a registry or a digest, references that do not follow the OCI reference grammar, and references carrying a URL scheme such as `oci://`, are rejected.
- `name` (String) Short name of the UIExtension resource.
- `parent` (String) The parent id for the UIExtension resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the extension.
- `display_name` (String) User friendly name for the extension. This is the name the TSB UI displays for it.
- `enabled` (Attributes) Whether the TSB UI loads this extension. Disabling an extension keeps it registered but stops the UI from serving it, so it can be turned back on without re-creating the resource. Defaults to true: when the field is omitted, on create or on update, the extension is enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enabled))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fully-qualified name of the UIExtension resource.
